What servtuner launcher reports about the machine it runs on (GET /machine): its GPUs from nvidia-smi, its CPU from /proc/cpuinfo and its memory from /proc/meminfo. A part it cannot read is left out and named in problems, never guessed.

Schema file: `schema/json/host-machine.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `e6069c17f6fe`.

## Top level

| Field          | Type                                                         | Required | Description                                                                                                                     |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `read_at`      | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)      | Yes      |                                                                                                                                 |
| `hostname`     | `string`                                                     | No       |                                                                                                                                 |
| `gpus`         | array of [hostGpu](/reference/schemas/host-machine/#hostgpu) | Yes      | One entry per GPU nvidia-smi lists; empty on a machine without NVIDIA GPUs or when nvidia-smi is missing (problems says which). |
| `cpu_model`    | `string`                                                     | No       |                                                                                                                                 |
| `cpu_cores`    | `integer`                                                    | No       | Logical CPUs. ≥ 1                                                                                                               |
| `memory_bytes` | `integer`                                                    | No       | MemTotal. ≥ 1                                                                                                                   |
| `problems`     | array of `string`                                            | Yes      |                                                                                                                                 |

## Definitions

### hostGpu

| Field            | Type      | Required | Description                                        |
| ---------------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`          | `string`  | Yes      | As nvidia-smi names it: "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070". |
| `memory_bytes`   | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 1                                                |
| `driver_version` | `string`  | No       |                                                    |
